summary: ECARX Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 2, 2026, announcing the integration of Tencent Cloud's WorkBuddy AI assistant into its Flyme AIOS platform across all Flyme devices, including automotive applications. The release references a previously announced definitive acquisition agreement for Flyme AIOS but provides no financial terms, pricing, or structural details about any transaction. This is an ordinary product and partnership announcement, not a special-situations event. No board action, advisors, or deal mechanics are disclosed. The event is routine business development; no special-situation category applies.
